options.name: behavior
options.description: The optional behavior that can be attached to the session when it is created. This controls the behavior when a session is invalidated.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

options.name: checks
options.description: Checks that are used to verify the session health. If all the checks fail, the session is invalidated and any locks associated with the session are released and can be acquired once the associated lock delay has expired.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The name of the datacenter in which the session exists or should be created.

options.name: delay
options.description: The optional lock delay that can be attached to the session when it is created. Locks for invalidated sessions ar blocked from being acquired until this delay has expired. Durations are in seconds.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the session, required when O(state) is either V(info) or V(remove).

options.name: name
options.description: The name that should be associated with the session. Required when O(state=node) is used.

options.name: node
options.description: The name of the node that with which the session is associated. By default this is the name of the agent.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the consul agent is running.

options.name: scheme
options.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to V(http) and can be set to V(https) for secure connections.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the session should be present, in other words it should be created if it does not exist, or absent, removed if present. If created, the O(id) for the session is returned in the output. If V(absent), O(id) is required to remove the session. Info for a single session, all the sessions for a node or all available sessions can be retrieved by specifying V(info), V(node) or V(list) for the O(state); for V(node) or V(info), the node O(name) or session O(id) is required as parameter.

options.name: token
options.description: The token to use for authorization.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Specifies the duration of a session in seconds (between 10 and 86400).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent.
